selection_rule: Keep exact high-depth Japan38 taxa used by the continuous-lightness gate and retain only strict-spatial observations with corolla_lab_lightness_n_usable_heads > 0; aggregate each environmental variable by species median over those same colour-usable observations.
lightness_validation: Species-median LAB lightness reconstructed from the selected source observations matches japan38_colour_continuous_bridge_v1.csv for all six concepts to stored numeric precision.
soil_coverage_warning: JPN_17 Cirsium maritimum has only 4 soil-linked colour-usable observations out of 14. Therefore soil cannot satisfy the same six-taxon >=5-environment-observation gate and is retained as a coverage blocker rather than a primary replicated mechanism test.
claim_boundary: Derived same-cohort species summaries only. Environment and lightness originate from the same strict-spatial observations, but this remains observational species-level evidence and does not establish causal environmental selection or historical exposure.
